text: ```yaml name: CI on: push: branches: [ main ] pull_request: branches: [ main ] jobs: build-and-test-python38: runs-on: ubuntu-latest strategy: matrix: python-version: [3.8] steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v2 - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }} uses: actions/setup-python@v2 with: python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }} - run: | python -m pip install --upgrade pip pip install setuptools wheel - run: python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel - run: pip install . - run: pytest build-and-test-python39: runs-on: ubuntu-latest strategy: matrix: python-version: [3.9] steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v2 - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }} uses: actions/setup-python@v2 with: python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }} - run: | python -m pip install --upgrade pip pip install setuptools wheel - run: python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel - run: pip install . - run: pytest build-and-test-python310: runs-on: ubuntu-latest strategy: matrix: python-version: [3.10] steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v2 - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }} uses: actions/setup-python@v2 with: python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }} - run: | python -m pip install --upgrade pip pip install setuptools wheel - run: python setup.py sdist bdist_wheel - run: pip install . - run: pytest generate-coverage-badge: needs: [build-and-test-python38, build-and-test-python39, build-and-test-python310] runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v2 - name: Set up Python 3.8 uses: actions/setup-python@v2 with: python-version: '3.8' - run: | python -m pip install --upgrade pip pip install setuptools wheel coverage codecov - run: coverage run -m pytest - run: coverage report -m - run: bash <(curl -s https://codecov.io/bash) - name: Commit coverage badge run: | echo "" >> README.md git add README.md git commit -m "Update README with coverage badge" git push origin main ```
